title: Classes
description: A class is created automatically the first time someone is assigned to it. It's numbered by the year the class finishes 6th grade (2016 = Class 5), and its grade and graduation update on their own each April. You can adjust years or delete unused classes.
cannotDelete: Classes with members, representatives or sent notifications can't be deleted.
members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {1 member} other {# members}}

hints.endChangesNumber: Changing this changes the class number.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.yearsOrder: The end year must be after the start year.
errors.beforeFirst: Class 1 finished 6th grade in 2012; earlier years aren't valid.

emptyHint: A class is created automatically the first time a member picks it when applying or in their profile.

reps.title: Class reps
reps.hint: Choose from this class's students and graduates. Class reps can send notices to their class and join the class reps chat.
